question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Dense
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e.** 'Sparse'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The English meaning of 'Dense' is 'closely compacted in substance'.(घना) 

 
 
• **Example:- '**The forest was dense with tall trees'.
 
 
 
• The correct antonym of **'Dense' **in the options given is **'Sparse'.** 
 
• The English meaning of **'Sparse'** is 'thinly dispersed or scattered'.(विरला) 
 
 
• **Example:- **'The trees in the desert were sparse'.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- 'Option 3' i.e. 'Sparse'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **'Compact'** English meaning is 'closely and neatly packed together; dense', (संक्षिप्त)
 
• Option 2** 'Secret'** English meaning is 'not known or seen or not meant to be known or seen by others',(रहस्य)
 
• Option 4 **'Generic' **English meaning is 'characteristic of or relating to a class or group of things; not specific',(जातीय)
